register.title: Register your company
register.subtitle: Your account starts on the Free plan with 10 welcome credits. An admin verifies your business registration before you can run checks.
register.nrcHint: The NRC of the person in charge. You will upload a scan of this card for verification.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Overview of your screening activity and pending work.
dashboard.pendingVerification: Your company is pending verification. Upload a DICA certificate or shop license, plus an NRC copy for the person in charge — an admin reviews them before you can submit checks.
dashboard.verifiedWithTierB: Your company is verified. You can run employment verifications and submit evidence-gated conduct reports.
dashboard.verifiedOnly: Your company is verified. You can run employment verifications.
dashboard.tierBDisabled: Conduct reports are disabled in this environment.
dashboard.pendingOnboarding: While your application is open you can upload documents and keep your contact details current. Checks, reports and billing unlock once we have verified your company.

credits.outOfCredits: You are out of credits. Searches and report views are paused until you top up or your next monthly credits arrive.
credits.freeActions: Registering and submitting reports are free. An accepted report earns 10 credits.
credits.lifetimes: How long credits last: welcome credits 1 month · monthly plan credits 3 months · purchased credits 6 months.

billing.title: Buy Credits
billing.subtitle: Pay by MMQR. Credits are added after we confirm the payment.
billing.currentPlan: You are on the {{plan}} plan ({{cycle}}), paid until {{date}}. Paying again extends from that date — you do not lose the days you have already paid for.
billing.noMethods: No payment method has been set up yet. Contact the platform operator.
billing.plansBlurb: A plan gives you bundled credits every month for as long as it is paid. Unused monthly credits roll over for 3 months. Credits you buy below are separate and last 6 months.
billing.packsBlurb: Top up without a plan, or top up on top of one.
billing.referenceInstruction: Put this reference in the transfer note
billing.referenceWarning: Without it we may not be able to find your payment.
billing.noQr: No QR image is set for {{method}}. Use the account details below.
billing.txnNumber: Transaction number from your payment app
billing.txnHint: The reference your wallet shows for this transfer. Each one can only be used once.
billing.notAutomatic: Credits are not added automatically. We check the payment against our records first — usually within one business day.
billing.submitted: Payment submitted. Credits are added once we match it against our records — usually within one business day.

verifications.title: Verifications
verifications.subtitle: Check an applicant against employer records. Each search costs {{cost}} credits.
verifications.noChecksHint: Submit a check to confirm an applicant's employment record.
verifications.answerSent: Sent. Your check is back in the review queue.

reports.title: Conduct Reports
reports.subtitle: Evidence-gated reports. A reviewer checks the evidence; accepted reports become visible to other verified employers.
reports.emptyHint: Reports require documentary evidence and pass admin evidence review before they are visible to other employers.
reports.draftCreated: Draft created. Attach documentary evidence, then submit for review.
reports.newReportWarning: Reports are limited to documented policy violations. A reviewer checks your evidence before anything is shared.
reports.nrcHint: Used to match this person across employers.
reports.withdrawWarning: Withdrawing removes this report from view for every other employer. It cannot be re-published — you would have to file again. Any credits awarded when it was accepted are reversed.
reports.withdrawn: Report withdrawn. It is no longer visible to other employers.
reports.withdrawnWithCredits: Report withdrawn. It is no longer visible to other employers. {{count}} credits awarded for its acceptance have been reversed.

access.title: Report Access
access.subtitle: Search by NRC for published conduct reports. A search costs {{cost}} credits; reading a report costs {{view}}.
access.noResults: No published reports found for that NRC.
access.requested: Access requested. A reviewer approves before you can read the report.

documents.title: Verification documents
documents.required: A DICA certificate or shop license, plus an NRC copy, are required before verification.
documents.rejectHint: The company sees this reason and re-uploads. Be specific about what is wrong.
documents.rejectReason: What is wrong with this document?
documents.rejectPlaceholder: e.g. The scan is cut off — page 2 is missing.

errors.insufficient_credits: You do not have enough credits for this. Top up or upgrade your plan to continue.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.conflict: That action is no longer possible.
errors.rate_limited: Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.mfa_required: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

profile.title: Profile
profile.subtitle: Your company details and your own account.
profile.lockedExplainer: These were confirmed when your company was verified, so they cannot be changed here. Contact the platform operator if any of them is wrong.
profile.lockedEmail: This is your sign-in address and cannot be changed here
profile.adminOnly: Only a company admin can change these details.
profile.contactEmailHint: For notices about your account. Separate from your sign-in address.
profile.lockedNationalId: The identity your company was verified against. Contact support to correct it.

admin.checkQueueSubtitle: Match each applicant against employer records and record the factual outcome.
admin.noEmploymentRecords: This platform holds no employment records
admin.noEmploymentRecordsBody: What follows is this platform's own history for this NRC — earlier checks and what reviewers concluded. None of it is an employment record, and an earlier “confirmed” is not evidence for this one. Confirm dates against the employer's records before choosing an outcome; what you record here is your attestation of that check.
admin.noOtherChecks: No other company has run a check on this person.
admin.priorChecksCaveat: These are what earlier reviewers typed, not employment records. Do not treat them as confirmation — re-check against the employer's records.
admin.recordOutcome: Record the factual outcome. No subjective judgment — dates and record existence only.
admin.resultOptional: Result (optional — a default is used if empty)
admin.reportReviewSubtitle: Check evidence sufficiency and category fit. Accepting publishes the report to other verified employers; rejecting discards it.
admin.accessRequestsSubtitle: Approve or deny an employer's request to read a published report.
admin.auditSubtitle: Every sensitive action, append-only. Reading this log is itself logged.
admin.oversightSubtitle: All conduct reports across companies (metadata only). Opening a report's content or evidence is individually logged — this is oversight, not bulk export.
admin.openedLogged: This report was opened by you and recorded in the audit log.
admin.paymentsSubtitle: Match each claimed payment against the wallet statement. Confirming adds the credits to the company's balance.
admin.checkStatement: Check the statement, not the screenshot
admin.checkStatementBody: A screenshot can be edited or reused. Confirm only if you can see this payment on the {{provider}} statement for the stated amount.
admin.companiesSubtitle: Confirm business registration against the DICA record, and suspend or reactivate access. Verification requires the documents to be on file.
admin.noDocuments: None — this company cannot be verified until documents are uploaded.
admin.enterpriseHint: Enterprise allowances are per contract, so set the monthly grant here.
admin.topUpHint: Record credits purchased once payment is confirmed — there is no payment integration yet.
admin.reasonAudited: Recorded in the audit log against your account.
admin.deactivateWarning: The company loses access immediately: its users can still sign in, but cannot submit verification checks or conduct reports, or request access to anyone's record. Reports it has already published stay published.
admin.reactivateInfo: Access is restored. The company returns to verified — its DICA registration was already confirmed and is not re-checked.
admin.docChecklistHint: Approve each document against the DICA record before verifying the company.
admin.readyToVerify: All required documents are approved. This company can be verified.
admin.cannotVerifyYet: Not ready to verify — these documents are still outstanding: {{missing}}
admin.verifyConsequences: Verifying lets this company run checks on real people and grants their welcome credits. Confirm the business against the DICA record first.
admin.verifiedNotice: Company verified. They can now sign in and run checks.

kind.documents.missing: Verification is waiting on these documents: {{missing}}
kind.company.suspended: Your company account has been suspended.
kind.verification.completed: A verification check has been completed.
kind.report.accepted: Your conduct report was accepted and published.
kind.report.rejected: Your conduct report was not accepted.

team.title: Team
team.subtitle: Who at your company can run checks and file reports, and what each of them has done.
team.name: Name
team.roleAdminHelp: Can invite colleagues, remove access, and change company details.
team.roleUserHelp: Can run checks and file reports. Cannot manage the team or billing.
team.inviteLinkOnce: Send this link to {{email}} yourself — we do not email it. It is shown once and cannot be retrieved later. It expires in 7 days.
team.mfaResetDone: {{name}} can set up 2-step sign-in again at their next sign-in.
team.deactivateNote: Removing access signs the person out immediately and blocks future sign-ins. Their past checks and reports stay on record under their name.

invite.heading: Join your team on WorkShield
invite.body: {{company}} has invited you to join as {{role}}. Choose a password to finish setting up your account.
invite.emailFixed: Set by the invitation and cannot be changed here.
invite.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
invite.invalid: This invitation link is not valid.
invite.invalidHint: It may have expired, already been used, or been revoked. Ask your administrator to send a new one.

receipts.title: Receipts
receipts.subtitle: Every payment, its receipt, and when your credits stop working.
receipts.noPaymentsHint: Receipts appear here once a payment is confirmed.
receipts.expiryNote: Credits are spent earliest-expiry first, so the ones nearest the top are used up before the rest.
receipts.creditsExpiryLine: {{count}} credits were added. They can be used until {{date}}.
receipts.renewsLine: Your {{plan}} plan runs until {{date}}. Paying again before then extends from that date.
receipts.footnote: This is a receipt for a payment we have confirmed receiving. It is not a tax invoice.

queue.reviewerNoteHelp: Internal. The employer never sees this — it is here so whoever picks this up next knows what you already tried.
queue.questionForEmployer: What do you need from the employer?
queue.questionHelp: They see this word for word, so ask for something specific.

stats.title: Statistics
stats.subtitle: Onboarding, credit consumption and revenue across the whole platform.
stats.noUsage: No credits were spent in this period.
stats.tierBOffNote: Conduct reports are switched off in this deployment — these are historical figures.
stats.byReviewerNote: Shown so a reviewer who accepts or rejects everything is visible, not to rank anyone.

nrc.incomplete: Choose the code from the card and enter the 6 digits.
nrc.unknownTownship: Not a code we recognise for this state — check it against the card.
nrc.pickFromList: Pick the township from the list — the code is stored in Latin letters.
